verdict.rationale: The pack contains only marketing-level privacy claims ('Your prompts are never tracked or trained on', 'Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine'). These state a no-tracking posture for prompts and local runs. They do not document a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control (setting, env var, or flag), nor do they cover usage tracking beyond prompts or the cloud service, so they are adjacent claims rather than the opt-out capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
